sections.content: Movement is expressed through verbs such as desplazarse, atravesar and dirigirse, together with prepositions and directional expressions. The choice of preposition depends on the relationship between the traveller and the place: hacia marks direction, por can describe movement through an area, and desde and hasta mark the starting point and endpoint.

items.spanish: Nos dirigimos hacia el centro porque la estación estaba cerrada.
items.english: We headed towards the centre because the station was closed.

items.spanish: El autobús atravesó la ciudad antes de llegar al aeropuerto.
items.english: The bus crossed the city before reaching the airport.

items.spanish: Nos desplazamos desde el hotel hasta la estación a pie.
items.english: We travelled from the hotel to the station on foot.

items.spanish: Caminamos por el casco antiguo mientras buscábamos la plaza.
items.english: We walked through the old town while we were looking for the square.

sections.content: Think of the preposition as describing the traveller's relationship to space: direction, route, origin or destination.
